newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Analyst comment on Ahold yr results.
newsitem.headline: Analyst comment on Ahold yr results.

text.p: Global retailer Ahold NV on Thursday reported 1996 net profit of 632.4 million guilders, 39 percent above 1995's 456.6 million. Analysts had forecast profit of 611-641 million guilders.
Below is a collection of analysts' comments.

"The net income was higher than expected, which has resulted in a higher than expected operating result. I had been quite cautious because of likely restructuring charges in the U.S. Overall, it looks splendid."

"It all looks terribly good, pretty much as expected. We had expected a share-split, but we had thought two-and-a-half for one was more likely. (Ahold plans to split its shares three-for-one) Everything seems to have gone well...the outlook is good and they will benefit strongly from the stronger dollar in the next few years."

"This was exactly as expected. The share split is also nice. It shouldn't in theory add to the value of the company, but it is a nice present. Of course in 1997, Ahold will benefit from the (strong) dollar and Stop and Shop will contribute for six and a half months in the U.S.... Earnings (this year) will depend on the dollar of course, but they could be up as much as 25 percent."
